subject.title: Dashboard: A2UI action-bridge capability — run canvas apps as dashboard widgets

question: Should OpenClaw implement A2UI canvas apps as dashboard widgets through the bundled dashboard bridge, or should browser Canvas action ingress land first as the canonical contract this bridge adapts to?
rationale: The work spans product direction and a security boundary: it depends on an unmerged dashboard widget host and would route sandboxed/browser-origin A2UI actions through trusted dashboard/Gateway code.

options.title: Sequence After Canvas Ingress
options.body: Keep this issue open and require the dashboard bridge to adapt to a maintainer-approved browser Canvas action-ingress contract from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497.

options.title: Design With Dashboard Host
options.body: Approve a joint bridge spec once the dashboard custom-widget host has a viable landing path, covering action authorization and sandbox invariants together.

options.title: Move Outward
options.body: If this is optional ecosystem work rather than bundled dashboard direction, ask for an external plugin or ClawHub package after any missing APIs are exposed.

recommendation.title: Sequence After Canvas Ingress
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require the dashboard bridge to adapt to a maintainer-approved browser Canvas action-ingress contract from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and merged the current bundled plugin-tab precedent and are the strongest current-main routing signal for whether this belongs in bundled Control UI/dashboard work.
